status.description: done = you reviewed the range the brief named and the findings below are your whole verdict; blocked = you could not finish (say what stopped you). no_work/refuted exist for the other roles and are read as blocked here.

message.description: One paragraph for the driver and the next round: what you read, what you probed by execution, what you could not probe. Evidence, not assurance.

verdict.description: Your verdict on THIS dimension's own findings: converged = no open blocker and no open major below; open = at least one. Minors never decide it. The driver derives the artifact's status line from the findings themselves and reports a disagreement.

findings.description: Every defect you are raising this round, one entry each. Empty when you found nothing at blocker/major/minor. The driver renders these into review-results/ under stable ids (r<round>-<dimension>-<n>); a finding without a dir/file.ext path is owned by no role and is refused.

path.description: dir/file.ext of the defect — a PATH, never a class or module name; findings are routed to the role whose write-scope owns the path.

line.description: Line number in path, 0 when the finding is about the file as a whole.

title.description: One line: what is wrong and why it matters.

evidence_command.description: The command that shows the defect (a failing probe, a grep, a test run). Empty only for a finding you could not reproduce by execution — say so in the title.

observed_output.description: What that command printed, trimmed to the lines that matter.

verifications.description: Optional. Earlier findings (by their r<round>-<dimension>-<n> id from the brief) you re-checked this round. A closure (resolved or refuted) is applied only when BOTH evidence fields are non-empty; a bare closure is refused and the finding stays open.
